article.title: が en respuesta a 誰が
article.part: Arquitectura básica de la oración — 文の基本構造
article.chapter: Tópico, sujeto y contraste: は/が — 主題・主語・対比：は／が

claims.summary: When a Japanese question uses 誰が — 'who?' — to ask for the identity of the subject, the response typically marks with が the person identified.
誰が combines the interrogative 誰 'who' with が. The answer substitutes this interrogative element with the corresponding name and normally maintains the same relationship with the predicate.
Examples provided illustrate the usage of が in responses to questions asking for the identity of the subject.
